description: Test class for MicrometerBasedMetrics, verifying its behavior in metrics recording, tenant timeout handling, and integration with Vert.x.

classes.name: MicrometerBasedMetricsTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for the MicrometerBasedMetrics class, testing telemetry reporting, tenant timeout handling, and metrics removal.

methods.name: registries
methods.description: Provides streams of different MeterRegistry instances (Prometheus and Graphite) for parameterized tests.

methods.name: testReportTelemetryWithOptionalQos
methods.description: Tests telemetry reporting with and without QoS tags, ensuring metrics are recorded correctly.

methods.name: testReportTelemetryWithUnknownTagValues
methods.description: Verifies that when QoS or TtdStatus are UNKNOWN or NONE, the tags are excluded or handled properly.

methods.name: testPayloadSizeForTelemetryMessages
methods.description: Checks that payload size calculations respect the configured minimum message size for telemetry messages.

methods.name: testPayloadSizeForCommandMessages
methods.description: Checks that payload size calculations respect the configured minimum message size for command messages.

methods.name: testNoTenantTimeoutOnDefault
methods.description: Ensures tenant timeout metrics are not collected when timeout settings are default or zero.

methods.name: testTimeoutEvent
methods.description: Verifies that a timeout event is scheduled when a message is sent and tenant idle timeout is configured.

methods.name: testTimeoutRemovesMetrics
methods.description: Checks that metrics are removed after tenant timeout expires and the timeout handler executes.

methods.name: testLastSeenIsUpdatedOnMessageSend
methods.description: Confirms that sending a message updates the last activity timestamp for the tenant.

methods.name: testLastSeenIsUpdatedOnDisconnect
methods.description: Ensures disconnect updates the last activity timestamp for the tenant.

methods.name: testLastSeenIsUpdatedOnConnect
methods.description: Checks that a new connection updates the last activity timestamp for the tenant.
